description.label: Description
description.value:
Calling upon the power of the Lady, you can summon a mystical, billowing mist. Upon stepping forward, you can travel to anywhere in Bretonnia, covering many miles of travel in but the blink of an eye—immediately appearing up to your Willpower in miles away. You must be in Bretonnia to use this spell. You must have Line of Sight or have personally visited the location you wish to travel to. If you have a map of Bretonnia, you may attempt a Navigation Test (Difficulty determined by the quality and accuracy of the map) to attempt to travel to a location you have not visited. On a success, you travel through the mist to the location in a manner determined by the GM.

Lore: Grail magics use the lore effects and ingredients of your Troth Wind (Azyr, Ghur, or Ghyran). See @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-journals.JournalEntry.szhETavVooj84NXa.JournalEntryPage.n0mJrnlLoreGrail]{Lore of the Grail}.
